scope: Formal rank-16 attention LoRA launch preflight
summary: The first formal launch stopped before creating an experiment because --dataset referenced the composite dataset parent instead of its train subdirectory.
evidence: validate_training_dataset rejected the inferred parent-level dataset-contract.json before GPU selection or model loading.
The accepted smoke configuration records the intended dataset root as the composite-v6-native16-2clips/train directory with 172 samples.
lessons: The launcher contract is explicit: --dataset is the split directory, while dataset-contract.json is resolved from its parent.
limitations: No optimizer step ran and no formal checkpoint was produced.
next_actions: Relaunch with the validated train split path and a new run identifier.
